output.reason: Reported month-long sleep-onset difficulty with stated preserved function and no reported alarm features can start with sleep-habit guidance, with clinician review if it continues or worsens.
output.patientMessage: You can start sleep-habit steps now: fixed wake time, avoid caffeine after midday, no alcohol or large meals late, keep the bedroom cool, dark and screen-free, and if you're awake about 20 minutes, get up and do something calm. Work stress commonly triggers this. Message us for clinician review if sleep stays poor after a few weeks, low mood or loss of interest appears, or you feel sleepy while driving.
differential: Acute/short-term insomnia related to work stress
